Week 8 review draft • 5 November 2026
Executive Summary

HumbleBeeAI’s public portfolio brings together applied AI delivery, products and research across document intelligence, computer vision, analytics and AI platforms. This client-facing review organizes 25 case studies, eight products, seven papers and two company updates; results are attributed to published materials, not independently audited, and product labels reproduce the supplied PDF snapshots.

content.text: Selected Flagship Work
Shelf Analysis AI platform for Retail Compliance

For an unnamed retail technology SaaS provider, product detection and shelf-position analysis address slow manual compliance audits across distributed stores. The source reports 90%+ detection accuracy and 80% less audit time within the first month across 500+ locations; the provider serves 600+ customers. These are source-reported figures; the source does not provide the accuracy definition or baseline audit hours.

Automated Training Pipeline Reduces Model Development Time

For retail technology and nontechnical model teams, Google Cloud Vertex AI automates training and deployment workflows that otherwise require specialist effort. The case reports development time falling from two months to two weeks (labelled 75% in the source) and 90% less training-management overhead for a client with more than 20 brands.
[Original case study](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/automated-training-pipeline) · PDF pp. 1–3.
Client Work
Document AI and automation

**Automating Customs Documentation with Local AI and Computer Vision.** An unnamed logistics and customs brokerage firm needed to reduce manual transcription of invoices, packing lists and IDs while keeping data local. Locally hosted OCR, computer vision and LLM extraction populate editable declaration templates. The case estimates up to 90% processing-time reduction and reports 97% fewer human errors versus manual entry; savings remain estimated, and MVP classification is user-selected, with automated classification planned. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/customs-document-automation) · PDF pp. 1–3.

content.text: **AI-powered Customs Intelligence System.** Fragmented HS-code definitions and historical declarations motivated a LangChain/GPT chatbot combining official definitions, semantic search and historical trade descriptions. Reported results are 76.5% Top-1 and 94.1% Top-3 HS-code accuracy, with MRR 0.8515; the stated corpus contains 65.5 million descriptions. Evaluation-set size and independent validation are not supplied. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/ai-customs-intelligence) · PDF pp. 1–4.

**Data Cleaning & Ingestion for HS Code Systems.** Scattered HS-code PDFs and duplicated trade descriptions obstructed retrieval. Official structures were normalized into Excel/MongoDB and descriptions deduplicated for Pinecone semantic search; about 65.5 million descriptions became about 2 million unique records, reported as a 97% reduction with frequency information retained. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/data-cleaning-hs-codes) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**Excel-based Automated Testing: Reducing Manual Validation Time.** Customs QA teams needed to validate large volumes of product descriptions more efficiently. An Excel-based FastAPI framework compares predicted and expected HS codes; its first run processed 11,000 descriptions in about four hours versus an estimated manual effort of more than a month. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/excel-automated-testing) · PDF pp. 1–4.

**LLM Results Analyzer: Unified Analysis Framework.** Customs classification users faced separate theoretical and historical systems and had to reconcile answers manually. Parallel Custom Clarification and Custom Optimization calls feed an analyzer LLM that preserves original outputs; the source reports unified, explained recommendations, without a quantified quality gain. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/llm-results-analyzer) · PDF pp. 1–4.
Computer vision

**A Global Beverage Leader Prevents Retail Fraud with AI.** An unnamed retail distribution technology provider addressed false or reused field-agent compliance evidence by integrating AI fraud detection with field-report and planogram workflows. The source reports over 90% fraudulent-submission detection accuracy in the first week and more than 90% improvement in audit reliability; the denominator and sample are not given, and client attribution needs confirmation. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/fraud-detection) · PDF pp. 1–4.

content.text: **Flexible Campaigns with Poster Recognition AI.** A retail technology/distribution provider sought to avoid repeated model training for each poster campaign. Recognition with instant reference-database updates reportedly achieved 94% accuracy, 90% less verification time and 85% lower deployment costs; the previous retraining cycle was three months. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/poster-recognition) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**Boosting Recognition Accuracy with AI-Powered Data Refinement.** For an unnamed workplace attendance/security organization, unusable face images and fragmented identities degraded attendance records. Image filtering, track-level identity aggregation, a virtual entry line and automatic face alignment reportedly improved data cleanliness and reduced misrecognition; the cited 5,000 unusable images per day describes the prior problem, not a measured reduction. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/improving-recognition-accuracy) · PDF pp. 1–3.

content.text: **IV Drip Flow Rate Estimator.** A medical technology provider sought to reduce the attention and observer variation involved in manual IV-drop counting. An offline iOS/Android camera estimator reportedly exceeds 95% accuracy and returns results within 15 seconds versus up to three minutes manually; the source describes this as over 10× faster. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/iv-drip-flow-rate-estimator) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**Field Center Detection for Augmented Reality in Sports.** An unnamed AR company needed to reduce manual field alignment. Offline mobile segmentation and keypoint estimation locate the field center and alignment points; the source reports real-time iOS/Android localization but supplies no numerical accuracy, latency or cost measure. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/field-center-detection) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**Predicting Carcass Quality Before Slaughter with On-Device Computer Vision.** Cattle producers and feedlot managers need quality signals before post-slaughter grading. A unified mobile detector/classifier predicts premium, medium and poor bands from live-cattle images; the source reports 95% “precision accuracy” and offline inference. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/beef-carcass-detection) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**LiveScore AI Revolutionizes Real-Time Basketball Scoring.** Event organizers and venues needed faster scoring and simpler live operations. On-premise video inference recognizes players and tricks and supports animated scores, persistent leaderboards and administration; faster scoring and more consistent operation are reported without quantified accuracy, latency or engagement lift. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/livescore-ai) · PDF pp. 1–4.

**Breast Cancer Biomarker Classification Revolutionizes Pathology Workflows.** Pathology workflows face costly, labor-intensive IHC testing. Models trained on IHC4BC predict ER, PR, Ki-67 and HER2 from H&E images in a web triage tool described as ready for clinical validation; no numerical diagnostic-performance result is supplied. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/breast-cancer) · PDF pp. 1–3. This is separate from the W-Net white-blood-cell paper.
Analytics

**Johnson & Johnson Achieves 96.8% Accuracy in Customer Targeting.** For purchase-propensity prediction across markets and datasets, an XGBoost pipeline uses preprocessing, feature engineering and SHAP explanations with a Flask prediction API. The case reports 96.8% accuracy; test size, class balance, baseline and conversion lift are not supplied. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/ai-based-predictive) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**How Johnson and Johnson Found Patterns Hidden in Ablation Data?** Patient-specific coordinates and fragmented procedure files impeded comparison. CARTONET normalizes XLSX/CSV data and enables statistical analysis and interactive 3D views; improved consistency and analysis efficiency are reported without a numerical measure. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/avnrt-ablation-analytics) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**How Johnson & Johnson Turned Endless Data Work into Instant Strategy?** Manual cleaning and fragmented product analysis consumed analyst time. Cartonet Analysis Dashboard automates processing, statistics and real-time visual reporting; the source reports 80% less manual effort. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/cartoned-analysis-dashboard) · PDF pp. 1–4.

**How Johnson & Johnson Turned a Mountain of Event Data into a Clear Story of ROI?** Disconnected event and procedure-volume records limited commercial analysis. Power BI integrates them with account/event comparisons and filters; the source reports improved effectiveness analysis and ROI visibility, not a quantified return or causal clinical impact. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/impact-event-analysis) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**How Johnson & Johnson reduced patient data analytics time by 80%?** Inconsistent Excel structures slowed parsing and preprocessing. Patient Report Analyzer adapts parsing, cleans data and uses batching and caching; reported outcomes include 80% less preprocessing/manual work and a separate 50% processing improvement. The source’s “time halved” and “50% faster” wording requires reconciliation. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/patient-data-analytics) · PDF pp. 1–3.

**Driving Brand Visibility on Generative AI.** Enterprise marketing, SEO and product teams needed a consistent way to measure brand visibility in generative engines. An Amazon QuickSight dashboard centralizes automated analytics; clearer analysis is reported, while the cover’s “100% automation” has no defined denominator. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/amplifyr) · PDF pp. 1–3.
AI platforms

**Enterprise Data Labeling Platform Deployment & Customization.** A computer-vision service provider needed isolated annotation environments, backup and scalable model-assisted workflows. A customized labeling platform with an ML backend and GCS-backed recovery reportedly supports 15+ isolated deployments, 75% less annotation time and 90%+ labeling accuracy. The source’s 99.9% data-protection reliability claim is omitted pending a defined measure.

**ROI Processing with Track-Timing Cuts LumioHub AI Costs.** Whole-frame processing and long-lived tracks strained compute and memory. Region-of-interest processing plus a 30-second track-duration mechanism reportedly lowers computation, stabilizes memory and speeds response; savings are not quantified, and 30 seconds is a configuration interval, not end-to-end latency. [Original case](https://humblebee.ai/case-studies/optimizing-recognition-processing) · PDF pp. 1–3.

content.text: Products
Status labels below reproduce published cover labels; “prod ready” is not an independent deployment certification.

**HStaff — prod ready.** Combines Hubstaff activity, Discord progress reports and team analytics for distributed-team leaders. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/hstaff) · Demo not supplied · PDF pp. 1–7.

**LumioHub AI — prod ready.** Workplace attendance, access visibility, presence analytics and reporting for multi-site organizations, HR and service providers. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/lumiohub) · [Demo](https://lumiohub.ai/) · PDF pp. 1–4.

**AI Avatar—Photorealistic Real-Time Conversational Avatar — prod demo.** Real-time voice/text avatars for customer service, education and communications. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/ai-avatar) · [Demo](https://avatar.humblebee.ai/) · PDF pp. 1–5.

**Kumush AI — prod demo.** Voice agent for calls, reservations and business workflows serving Uzbek-speaking customers. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/kumush-ai) · [Demo](https://kumush.ai/) · PDF pp. 1–5.

**Wakil AI — prod ready.** Evidence-based multilingual legal assistant and lawyer marketplace for individuals, businesses and legal professionals in Uzbekistan; Wakil AI Associate is upcoming. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/wakil-ai) · [Demo](https://wakil.ai/) · PDF pp. 1–6.

**Bojhona: AI-Powered Customs Intelligence: HS Code Definitions — in dev.** Brings HS definitions together with historical descriptions for customs and trade users. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/bojhona) · Demo not supplied · PDF pp. 1–3.

**Enlighten Qalb: AI Spiritual Guide — prod ready.** Memory-enabled companion grounded in curated spiritual sources. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/enlighten-qalb) · Demo not supplied · PDF pp. 1–8.

**bRide: Empowering Human Potential through AI Execution — in dev.** Human-guided AI execution and longitudinal professional-growth support for knowledge workers and organizations. [Profile](https://humblebee.ai/projects/bride) · Demo not supplied · PDF pp. 1–4.
